author: stephtea
title: Win SMS hold billing B1: manual-capture hold at checkout
body:
First money slice of the Win p2p SMS hold-billing project. Converts the Win p2p
checkout from an immediate charge to a manual-capture authorization hold and
records it on the `OutreachP2pSms` billing satellite. Everything is gated behind
the new `WIN_SMS_HOLD_BILLING` flag (default off) and inert in prod when off:
the existing immediate-charge checkout runs unchanged. Capture and release are
later slices; the flag stays off in prod until the whole chain is built and
validated.

## Why a hold instead of a charge

A p2p send is priced on an estimate, and the true billable count is only known
after the Peerly list is built and scrubbed. Reserving the funds up front and
capturing the actual amount later avoids both over-charging the candidate and
under-collecting — the same hold-then-capture discipline the robocall flow uses.

## What changes when the flag is ON (vs OFF)

- **Checkout** authorizes a manual-capture hold (`payment_intent_data.capture_method = 'manual'`) instead of charging immediately. Scoped to Win p2p (`TEXT` + `outreachType p2p`); Serve, polls, and domains are untouched. `receipt_email` is preserved. Flag off: automatic capture, byte-for-byte unchanged.
- **Hold amount is UNDISCOUNTED**: the free-texts (5,000) discount is NOT applied at hold time, so a later capture can apply it and never exceed the authorized amount even if eligibility shifts. A sub-50c undiscounted hold is below Stripe's authorization floor, so it is forgiven (amount 0 → existing free path, no hold) rather than failing checkout.
- **Fulfillment**: a manual-capture session completes with `payment_status: 'unpaid'` (funds held, not captured). `completeCheckoutSession` now fulfills such a session when its live PI is `requires_capture`, instead of deferring it the way it defers an ACH payment. Narrowed to flag + `TEXT`, so every other unpaid session still defers; inert when the flag is off.
- **Satellite**: on the completed webhook (the existing `executePostPurchase` → `finalizeOutreachPurchase` path), the hold is recorded on `OutreachP2pSms` before finalizing the send.

## Money safety

- The hold is **verified before it is stamped**: `outreachP2pSmsHold.service.ts` re-reads the live PaymentIntent and only records `authorized` (with `authorizationIntentId`, the `requires_capture` amount, and `captureBefore`) when the PI actually reached `requires_capture`. A confirmed PI in any other state is a decline (`hold_failed`), never a usable hold.
- **One hold per send**: because Stripe places the hold at checkout, recording is a single single-owner CAS straight from `pending_payment → authorized` on the satellite's `@unique` outreach row. A webhook replay or a duplicate completed session finds the row already advanced and no-ops — it never records a second hold. (A direct transition avoids a `hold_pending` intermediate the satellite has no stale-recovery sweep for.)
- Nothing is captured here.

---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Touches payment checkout, webhook fulfillment, and new billing satellite state for money holds; mitigated by default-off flag and narrow TEXT+p2p scope, but incorrect deferral or hold stamping could strand or mis-record authorizations.
> 
> **Overview**
> Adds **Win p2p SMS hold billing (slice B1)** behind the new `WIN_SMS_HOLD_BILLING` kill switch (default off). When enabled, Win p2p (`TEXT` + `outreachType: p2p`) checkout **authorizes a Stripe manual-capture hold** instead of charging immediately: checkout pricing uses the **undiscounted** text count (free-texts discount deferred to a later capture), amounts under 50¢ route to the existing zero-amount free path, and Stripe sessions get `capture_method: 'manual'`.
> 
> **Fulfillment** no longer defers `payment_status: unpaid` for these TEXT sessions when the live PaymentIntent is `requires_capture` (distinct from ACH deferral). Post-purchase, **`OutreachP2pSmsHoldService`** verifies the PI and CAS-records `authorized` (or `hold_failed`) on `OutreachP2pSms` **before** `finalizeOutreachPurchase`; webhook replays are idempotent. Capture/release and approve/send gating are explicitly out of scope.
> 
> Docs/env schema and unit tests cover purchase, Stripe session creation, hold recording, and checkout completion behavior.

+import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing'
+import { PinoLogger } from 'nestjs-pino'
+import { getUnixTime } from 'date-fns'
+import Stripe from 'stripe'
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { PrismaService } from '@/prisma/prisma.service'
+import { createMockLogger } from '@/shared/test-utils/mockLogger.util'
+import { firstOrThrow } from 'src/shared/test-utils/arrays.util'
+import { StripeService } from 'src/vendors/stripe/services/stripe.service'
+import { P2pSmsSettleState } from 'src/generated/prisma'
+import { OutreachP2pSmsHoldService } from './outreachP2pSmsHold.service'
+
+const OUTREACH_ID = 7788
+const SESSION_ID = 'cs_test_hold'
+const INTENT_ID = 'pi_test_hold'
+
+// A manual-capture hold completes at requires_capture; amount is the authorized
+// (undiscounted) estimate in cents.
+const mockIntent = (
+  overrides: Partial<Stripe.PaymentIntent> = {},
+): Stripe.PaymentIntent =>
+  ({
+    id: INTENT_ID,
+    object: 'payment_intent',
+    status: 'requires_capture',
+    amount: 10500,
+    ...overrides,
+  }) as Stripe.PaymentIntent
+
+describe('OutreachP2pSmsHoldService.recordHold', () => {
+  let service: OutreachP2pSmsHoldService
+  let model: {
+    upsert: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>
+    updateMany: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>
+  }
+  let stripe: {
+    retrieveCheckoutSession: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>
+    retrievePaymentIntent: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>
+  }
+
+  // The args of the single updateMany call whose data would set `authorized`,
+  // or undefined if no such call was made. (A call with count 0 is still a call
+  // — the CAS guard, not the data, is what makes it a no-op on a replay.)
+  const authorizedCall = () =>
+    model.updateMany.mock.calls
+      .map((call) => call[0])
+      .find((args) => args?.data?.settleState === P2pSmsSettleState.authorized)
+
+  beforeEach(async () => {
+    model = { upsert: vi.fn(), updateMany: vi.fn() }
+    stripe = {
+      retrieveCheckoutSession: vi
+        .fn()
+        .mockResolvedValue({ payment_intent: INTENT_ID }),
+      retrievePaymentIntent: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(mockIntent()),
+    }
+
+    const moduleRef = await Test.createTestingModule({
+      providers: [
+        OutreachP2pSmsHoldService,
+        { provide: PrismaService, useValue: { outreachP2pSms: model } },
+        { provide: StripeService, useValue: stripe },
+        { provide: PinoLogger, useValue: createMockLogger() },
+      ],
+    }).compile()
+
+    service = moduleRef.get(OutreachP2pSmsHoldService)
+  })
+
+  it('stamps authorized with the live intent id and amount on requires_capture', async () => {
+    const captureBefore = getUnixTime(new Date('2026-02-01T00:00:00Z'))
+    stripe.retrievePaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(
+      mockIntent({
+        // capture_before is returned on a manual-capture auth but absent from
+        // the SDK type.
+        ...({ capture_before: captureBefore } as Partial<Stripe.PaymentIntent>),
+      }),
+    )
+    model.updateMany.mockResolvedValue({ count: 1 })
+
+    await service.recordHold({
+      outreachId: OUTREACH_ID,
+      checkoutSessionId: SESSION_ID,
+    })
+
+    const stamp = authorizedCall()
+    expect(stamp?.data).toMatchObject({
+      settleState: P2pSmsSettleState.authorized,
+      authorizationIntentId: INTENT_ID,
+      authorizedAmountInCents: 10500,
+    })
+    expect(stamp?.data?.captureBefore).toEqual(new Date('2026-02-01T00:00:00Z'))
+  })
+
+  it('stamps straight from pending_payment via a single CAS (no hold_pending)', async () => {
+    model.updateMany.mockResolvedValue({ count: 1 })
+
+    await service.recordHold({
+      outreachId: OUTREACH_ID,
+      checkoutSessionId: SESSION_ID,
+    })
+
+    // Exactly one DB transition, guarded on the exact prior state, straight to
+    // authorized — never a hold_pending intermediate that could strand.
+    expect(model.updateMany).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+    expect(firstOrThrow(model.updateMany.mock.calls)[0]).toMatchObject({
+      where: {
+        outreachId: OUTREACH_ID,
+        settleState: P2pSmsSettleState.pending_payment,
+        authorizationIntentId: null,
+      },
+      data: { settleState: P2pSmsSettleState.authorized },
+    })
+  })
+
+  it('records hold_failed, not authorized, when the PI is confirmed but not requires_capture', async () => {
+    stripe.retrievePaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(
+      mockIntent({ status: 'processing' }),
+    )
+    model.updateMany.mockResolvedValue({ count: 1 })
+
+    await service.recordHold({
+      outreachId: OUTREACH_ID,
+      checkoutSessionId: SESSION_ID,
+    })
+
+    expect(authorizedCall()).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(firstOrThrow(model.updateMany.mock.calls)[0]).toMatchObject({
+      where: {
+        outreachId: OUTREACH_ID,
+        settleState: P2pSmsSettleState.pending_payment,
+        authorizationIntentId: null,
+      },
+      data: { settleState: P2pSmsSettleState.hold_failed },
+    })
+  })
+
+  it('does not place a second hold when the row already advanced (replay / second session)', async () => {
+    // The row is already past pending_payment, so the single-owner CAS matches
+    // nothing and updates zero rows.
+    model.updateMany.mockResolvedValue({ count: 0 })
+
+    await service.recordHold({
+      outreachId: OUTREACH_ID,
+      checkoutSessionId: SESSION_ID,
+    })
+
+    // Exactly one guarded write, and it is a no-op (count 0) — no second hold
+    // is recorded and no retry re-writes.
+    expect(model.updateMany).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+    expect(authorizedCall()?.where).toMatchObject({
+      settleState: P2pSmsSettleState.pending_payment,
+      authorizationIntentId: null,
+    })
+  })
+
+  it('records nothing when the completed session carries no PaymentIntent', async () => {
+    stripe.retrieveCheckoutSession.mockResolvedValue({ payment_intent: null })
+
+    await service.recordHold({
+      outreachId: OUTREACH_ID,
+      checkoutSessionId: SESSION_ID,
+    })
+
+    expect(model.upsert).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(model.updateMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(stripe.retrievePaymentIntent).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  })
+})

+import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common'
+import { addDays, fromUnixTime } from 'date-fns'
+import Stripe from 'stripe'
+import { createPrismaBase, MODELS } from 'src/prisma/util/prisma.util'
+import { isUniqueConstraintError } from 'src/prisma/util/prismaErrors.util'
+import { StripeService } from 'src/vendors/stripe/services/stripe.service'

+// Records the Win p2p SMS authorization hold on the OutreachP2pSms satellite
+// after the checkout session completes. The hold itself is placed by Stripe at
+// checkout (payment_intent_data.capture_method = 'manual'); this service's job
+// is to VERIFY that hold against the live PaymentIntent and record it durably,
+// single-owner. Because the hold is already placed, recording is pure DB work
+// with no in-flight external call — so the transition is a single CAS straight
+// from pending_payment -> authorized (guarded on the exact prior state), rather
+// than the hold_pending intermediate the robocall placement needs for a Stripe
+// call that runs between claim and commit. There is no stale-recovery sweep for
+// this satellite, and a direct transition can never strand a row mid-record. The
+// `@unique` outreachId plus the CAS guarantee exactly one hold per send: a
+// webhook replay or a second completed session for the same send finds the row
+// already advanced and no-ops. No capture here (slice C1) and no approve/send
+// gate change (slice D1).
+@Injectable()
+export class OutreachP2pSmsHoldService extends createPrismaBase(
+  MODELS.OutreachP2pSms,
+) {
+  constructor(private readonly stripe: StripeService) {
+    super()
+  }
+
+  // `checkoutSessionId` is the `cs_...` id from the completed webhook. The caller
+  // (the p2p post-purchase handler) only invokes this on the paid checkout path
+  // under the flag, so the session always has a PaymentIntent.
+  async recordHold({
+    outreachId,
+    checkoutSessionId,
+  }: {
+    outreachId: number
+    checkoutSessionId: string
+  }): Promise<void> {
+    const intent = await this.resolveHeldIntent(checkoutSessionId)
+    if (!intent) {

+    // decline, not money we can later capture. Move to the hold_failed terminal

+    // prior state (pending_payment, no intent) so a replay or a second completed
+    // session no-ops.

+    // authorized. The hold is ALREADY placed by Stripe at checkout, so recording
+    // it is pure DB work with no in-flight external call to crash between a claim
+    // and its commit — a direct transition (rather than a hold_pending
+    // intermediate, which the satellite has no stale-recovery sweep for) can
+    // never strand a row mid-record. The `@unique` outreachId plus this CAS
+    // guarantee exactly one hold is recorded per send: a webhook replay or a
+    // second completed session for the same outreach finds the row already past

+    // PI, never a client-supplied number.

+        settleState: P2pSmsSettleState.pending_payment,

+        authorizationIntentId: intent.id,
+        authorizedAmountInCents: intent.amount,
+      },
+      'win sms hold: authorized hold recorded on satellite',
+    )
+  }

+  // Resolves the manual-capture PaymentIntent behind a completed checkout
+  // session, re-read live so the stamp reflects the authoritative money state.
+  private async resolveHeldIntent(
+    checkoutSessionId: string,
+  ): Promise<Stripe.PaymentIntent | null> {

+      typeof session.payment_intent === 'string'

+  // Stripe returns capture_before (Unix seconds) on a manual-capture auth, but

+  private resolveCaptureBefore(intent: Stripe.PaymentIntent): Date {
+    const captureBeforeUnix = (
+      intent as Stripe.PaymentIntent & { capture_before?: number | null }
+    ).capture_before

+      ? fromUnixTime(captureBeforeUnix)
+      : addDays(new Date(), WIN_SMS_HOLD_WINDOW_DAYS)
+  }

priorFindings.body:
`allowPromoCodes: true` is set unconditionally, including when `manualCapture` is true (Win SMS p2p hold). The hold design relies on the hold being the **undiscounted** amount so a later capture can never exceed it. A Stripe promotion code applied at checkout reduces the PaymentIntent `amount` to the discounted total, and `outreachP2pSmsHold.service.ts` line 106 stores that reduced `intent.amount` as `authorizedAmountInCents`. When slice C1 capture is built and uses `authorizedAmountInCents` as the cap, actual SMS costs can exceed the held (discounted) amount — silently undercharging the customer.

The code comment at line 174–175 ("amount is already the UNDISCOUNTED hold") is misleading: it conflates the app-level free-texts discount suppression (which the handler correctly skips under the flag) with Stripe-level promotion code suppression — these are different mechanisms. Nothing in `stripe.service.ts` suppresses `allow_promotion_codes` when `capture_method: 'manual'` is set.

(Falsification check: `allowPromoCodes` is hardcoded `true` at line 193 with no branch on `manualCapture`; `stripe.service.ts` line 767 forwards it independently of `capture_method`; `outreachP2pSmsHold.service.ts` line 106 stores raw `intent.amount` with no guard against a promo-reduced PI.)
